description: Get roster details for a specific team, current by default and historical on request. Exact payload varies by platform: ESPN and Yahoo return player entries with lineup/position context, while Sleeper returns starters, bench, reserve, taxi, and record metadata for the selected roster. A current ESPN football roster includes seasonPoints and pointsPerGame under the league’s scoring rules. A missing or null value means unknown. For an ESPN football week snapshot, week selects the roster and lineup. Player stats use the season totals ESPN returns, which may include games after that week. For weekly individual fantasy points, use get_matchups with detail set to "players", week, and team_id (2018 season or later). ESPN baseball uses HR for batting and HR_allowed for pitching. A selected current Sleeper team can return weekly player points when the regular-season week is confirmed (snapshot.pointsWeek). An absent player score means unknown. Keeper fields are additive and platform-dependent; never assume one provider's keeper fields or units exist on another. ESPN adds per-player keeperValue and keeperValueFuture plus one response-level keeperValueUnit of auction_dollars or draft_round, omitted rather than guessed when ESPN's draft type does not determine it; a historical snapshot withholds keeperValueFuture and flags keeperValueFutureAvailable false. Sleeper resolves keepers to player entries on the current roster only, passing the list through as Sleeper sends it; an empty or null list does not show that the league has no keepers. Yahoo entries may add isKeeper as status, cost, and kept when Yahoo sends it; Yahoo has only been observed returning cost as false, so no numeric keeper cost is available from Yahoo. On a current Yahoo roster only, entries may also add isUndroppable and isEditable. These are Yahoo player flags, not comprehensive transaction or lineup-lock rules: isEditable does not provide a lock time or guarantee that an add, drop, or lineup move is legal. Current Yahoo entries may also add eligiblePositions from Yahoo metadata, preserving provider-native codes and order without filtering or mapping to another platform's labels. This is separate from the assigned slot and does not prove that a move is legal. Honor codes Yahoo explicitly lists, including flex codes; do not infer additional eligibility. Missing, empty, or malformed eligibility is omitted; an absent eligiblePositions means unknown, not ineligible. Historical Yahoo snapshots omit eligiblePositions and both flags. Historical snapshots: pass week for football (all platforms) and Sleeper basketball (matchup week), or as_of_date (YYYY-MM-DD) for ESPN/Yahoo baseball, basketball, and hockey, never both. An invalid selector returns a corrective error naming the right one, except that a positive whole-number week on ESPN or Yahoo baseball, basketball, or hockey returns the current roster, with snapshot.requested_week and snapshot.note saying the week was ignored. Every response includes a snapshot block identifying what was returned (current vs week vs date); historical responses may add limitation flags (acquisitionMetadataAvailable, reserveAndTaxiClassificationAvailable) when provider history omits those details. A current Sleeper roster sets limitations.playerStatusAvailable false when it could not confirm the league is live this season and so withheld injury designations; a missing injuryStatus then does not mean the player is healthy. Yahoo baseball, basketball and hockey entries add stats named by the league's own categories (season to date by default; stats_window 'date' with stats_date YYYY-MM-DD gives one day, default today in US Eastern time), plus fantasyPoints in points leagues and, for the season window, fantasyPointsPerGame. Yahoo football entries keep their weekly points and add that week's stats, or season stats with stats_window 'season'. Season stats are season to date even on a historical as_of_date roster. statsCoverage names the window returned. When Yahoo does not return stats, limitations.playerStatsAvailable is false and entries have no stats; missing stats means unknown, not zero. A stats_window other than 'season' is Yahoo-only. For "roster during matchup week N" questions in daily sports, ask the user for a specific date rather than guessing. One matchup spans several daily rosters. Use established session context (call get_user_session only if needed), then get_league_info for the specified league if this chat has not already loaded it, so the model already knows the league's team names, owner/team mapping, league settings, and roster context before interpreting this roster. Requires authentication except on Sleeper's public API. Read-only.

as_of_date.description: Historical calendar-day roster snapshot in YYYY-MM-DD format. ESPN and Yahoo baseball, basketball, and hockey only — football and Sleeper use week. Omit for the current roster; pass at most one of week or as_of_date.

league_id.description: League ID (get from get_user_session), passed whole, exactly as returned; Yahoo IDs include a season prefix, like 449.l.12345

season_year.description: Season start year — use the season_year returned by get_user_session for this league; only pass an older year when the user explicitly asks about a past season. Basketball and hockey use the start year of a cross-year season (2024 = the 2024-25 season); football and baseball use the single season year (2025 = the 2025 season).

stats_date.description: Yahoo baseball, basketball and hockey only, with stats_window 'date': the calendar day for each player's stats, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in US Eastern time.

stats_window.description: Yahoo only: window for each player's stats. 'season' (season to date), 'date' (baseball, basketball, hockey; use with stats_date), or 'week' (football only; the stat week is the roster week, so pass week instead of stats_week). Default: season, except football, where the default is the roster's weekly stats. Other platforms accept only 'season'.

team_id.description: Team ID for the target roster. Recommended for all platforms; required on Yahoo and for historical Sleeper rosters. If omitted, platform behavior varies and may not resolve to the user's team.

week.description: Historical weekly roster snapshot (positive integer). Football on all platforms, plus Sleeper basketball (matchup week). Not valid for ESPN/Yahoo daily sports — use as_of_date there. Omit for the current roster; pass at most one of week or as_of_date.

name: get_roster

data.description: Platform envelope. Field availability varies by platform (ESPN, Yahoo, Sleeper); absent fields are not provided by that platform.

playerStatsAvailable.description: Yahoo only: false when Yahoo did not return usable per-player stats for some or all entries; those entries have no stats (unknown, not zero)

players.description: Yahoo roster entries. eligiblePositions, isUndroppable and isEditable, when present, apply only to a current roster; historical snapshots omit them

eligiblePositions.description: Yahoo current-roster provider-native eligible position codes, unfiltered and in provider order. Omitted when missing, empty, malformed, or historical; absence means unknown, not ineligible. Honor codes Yahoo explicitly lists, including flex codes; do not infer additional eligibility or move legality. Separate from the assigned slot

fantasyPoints.description: Yahoo points leagues only: the player's fantasy points for statsCoverage.window, as Yahoo computed them under the league scoring. Absent in categories leagues and when Yahoo returned none; on a Yahoo football roster read with the default week window it is also absent because the roster's points field carries it

fantasyPointsPerGame.description: Yahoo points leagues, season window only: fantasyPoints divided by the stat line's games played (GP), rounded to 2 decimals. Absent when games played is missing or 0

isEditable.description: Yahoo current-roster player flag for whether Yahoo reports the player as editable. It is not a lock time and does not guarantee a particular add, drop, or lineup move is legal

isUndroppable.description: Yahoo current-roster player flag. It reports Yahoo's undroppable status for this player, not every condition that may affect a transaction

stats.description: The player's stat line. ESPN: season stats keyed by ESPN's stat names, on rosters and ordinary free-agent lists. ESPN baseball uses HR for home runs hit and HR_allowed for home runs allowed. H, BB, IBB, HBP and R follow the same pattern. Yahoo: the stat line for statsCoverage.window, keyed by the league's own category names (STAT_<id> when Yahoo's names were unavailable; see warning), with numbers where Yahoo sends a number and a string where it sends a ratio or time such as "11/40". Absent means the provider returned no stats for this player: unknown, not zero

pointsPerGame.description: Current ESPN football roster only. ESPN’s actual season fantasy points per game under the league scoring rules.

seasonPoints.description: Current ESPN football roster only. Actual season total under the league scoring rules.

rosters.description: Sleeper league-wide roster list when no team is selected

unowned.description: Sleeper only: the team has no manager. ownerName is then null and teamName is Flaim's label "Unowned team (roster N)", not a name set in Sleeper

snapshot.description: Identifies what was returned: current, week, or date

pointsWeek.description: Current Sleeper team roster only. Fantasy week used for the player points lookup. Individual scores may still be unavailable.

statsCoverage.description: Yahoo only: the window the per-player stats cover (season to date, one date, or one football week) and the scope of the stat names (league_categories). Present only when at least one entry has stats

unowned.description: Sleeper only: the team has no manager. ownerName is then null and teamName is Flaim's label "Unowned team (roster N)", not a name set in Sleeper

warning.description: Yahoo only: plain-language notes, for example when player stats or stat names were unavailable

title: Team Roster
